channels.label: VIBRATION
channels.note: No real counterpart. NGAFID-MC carries no accelerometer channel, so vibration is generated from the physics model's combustion-balance state and tagged synthetic everywhere it appears.
channels.source_note: No real counterpart in NGAFID-MC. Generated by the physics model and tagged SIMULATED at every layer.

channels.label: INJECTION TIMING
channels.note: No real counterpart. Injection/ignition timing is not published in NGAFID-MC; it is derived from the physics model's operating point and tagged synthetic everywhere it appears.
channels.source_note: No real counterpart in NGAFID-MC. Generated by the physics model and tagged SIMULATED at every layer.

note: The twin's data contract. Sixteen channels are measured, two are generated by the physics model because NGAFID-MC carries no accelerometer and publishes no injection timing. Any adapter that satisfies this contract - an authorised test-rig export, a live CAN feed - drops into the same slot with no change downstream.

adapter_contract.note: Anything satisfying this interface drops in without a change downstream. That is the answer to data that cannot leave its own facility.
